description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractAdapter' which provides common functionality for adapting messages in a protocol. It includes methods for converting between internal data models and external protocol messages, handling headers, and mapping topics and signals. It also manages header translation and payload matching strategies.

classes.name: AbstractAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class providing common methods for converting between internal signal representations and external protocol messages, managing headers, and processing topic paths.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an external adaptable message into an internal JSONifiable signal, handling header translation and type determination.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the type string for an adaptable message based on its topic path and payload.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Extracts the criterion component as a string from a topic path, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: addTopicPathInfo
methods.description: Adds extra header information from a topic path to existing headers.

methods.name: mapTopicPathToHeaders
methods.description: Maps a topic path to Ditto headers, including entity ID and channel.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Maps an internal signal to an external adaptable message, adding headers and setting the channel.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Abstract method to map a signal to an adaptable message; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: headerTranslator
methods.description: Provides access to the header translation component used in message conversions.

methods.name: upperCaseFirst
methods.description: Utility method to capitalize the first letter of a string.
